tools.name: Audit client data runtime
tools.description: Checks that the active client-data snapshot is complete and can be loaded by the server.
tools.usage: Run without arguments after updating client_data.

tools.name: Audit game data
tools.description: Validates extracted game data and reports missing or inconsistent records.
tools.usage: Run without arguments; review the generated report.

tools.name: Build mechanics map
tools.description: Builds the editable mechanics-map dataset from imported evidence.

tools.name: Build protocol snapshot
tools.description: Creates a versioned protocol-data snapshot from the client extraction.
tools.usage: Run after extracting a new Dofus version.

tools.name: Build server client-data snapshot
tools.description: Builds the server-ready client-data manifest and validation snapshot.
tools.usage: Run after game-data import or extraction.

tools.name: Export monster mechanics baseline
tools.description: Exports the editable baseline for monster mechanics.
tools.usage: Run to refresh mechanics source files; no arguments required.

tools.name: Export packet evidence
tools.description: Exports durable unknown-packet telemetry for protocol analysis.
tools.usage: Use --summary for a compact report or --id N for one capture.

tools.name: Extract client snapshot
tools.description: Extracts client game data into the versioned client_data directory.
tools.usage: Run after the Dofus client is updated.

tools.name: Extract houses
tools.description: Extracts house templates and placement evidence from the client data.
tools.usage: Run after a new client snapshot.

tools.name: Extract jobs
tools.description: Extracts jobs, skills and profession-related game data.
tools.usage: Run after a new client snapshot.

tools.name: Extract world transitions
tools.description: Extracts interactive world transitions such as doors, stairs and ladders.

tools.name: Import DofusDude catalogues
tools.description: Downloads and version-validates documented Dofus 3 catalogue data.
tools.usage: Run to refresh external catalogue imports.

tools.name: Fetch official Dofus evidence
tools.description: Collects official Dofus website and patch evidence for parity research.
tools.usage: Run when refreshing documented source evidence.

tools.name: Generate parity ledger
tools.description: Builds the emulator/client parity ledger and identifies coverage gaps.
tools.usage: Run without arguments after updating implementation or data.

tools.name: Investigate data gaps
tools.description: Finds missing game-data relationships that require extraction or evidence.

tools.name: Repair game data
tools.description: Applies safe repair steps for known extracted-data inconsistencies.
tools.usage: Review tool output before restarting the server.

tools.name: Review unknown packets
tools.description: Reads and triages the durable unknown-packet queue.
tools.usage: Use --new for actionable captures, --investigating for backlog, --summary for counts, or --id N for a sample.

tools.name: Inspect client bundles
tools.description: Inspects Unity bundles for client game-data content.
tools.usage: Run without arguments unless the tool output requests a focused follow-up.

tools.name: Inspect maps
tools.description: Inspects extracted map data and interactive elements.
